sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the required ship-to-structuralMember path, places all operand and result quantities on structuralMember, uses the supplied canonical terms and recommended units, and includes the required presence constraints. The COMPLEX_READINESS contract makes the formula informational and declares no calculation or evidence structure, so no formula execution or generic evidence constraints are required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add sh:minCount 1 to nltl:hasStructuralMember on the ship shape and to each declared operand/result property—nltl:netFlangeThickness, nltl:yieldStrength, and nltl:flangeOutstand—on the structural-member shape.
